turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me, and I want it withdrawn.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Let's skip the pleasantries. On what basis did you enter that zero, and who decided it?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me. On what basis was the zero entered, Hale?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? I asked who decided the zero and on what basis, and I still don't have an answer.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided, and what do you have besides a score from software?
